notes: ⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium needed). This is a Next.js React application that loads all listing data dynamically via API calls after page load. The initial HTML only contains the page structure (header, footer, filters) but no actual listing data. A headless browser is required to wait for the JavaScript to execute and populate the listings. Alternative URL patterns found: /listings, /businesses-for-sale. The site uses CSS module classes (e.g., search_searchResult__r7ZTA, Restaurant_wsSelectors__p4Eg7) which may change between builds. Once rendered, listings likely appear in card elements within the search results section. API endpoint investigation recommended as an alternative approach.
